title: Python generic SCHC selection mislabels plaintext as OSCORE
description: Rules 5/6 have descriptors identical to plaintext Rules 0/1, and SchcContext orders OSCORE rules first. Generic compress(fields) therefore selects OSCORE labels for plaintext header fields; the rule_versioning vector explicitly expects this, contradicting the security-audit marker. Add a trusted parsed/authenticated OSCORE discriminator to matching or exclude Rules5/6 from generic selection, update vectors, and add plaintext/OSCORE negative and positive tests so compressed Rule IDs cannot falsely assert security state.
notes: Independent rereview found generic standardized decompression still accepted Rules5/6 without parsed OSCORE proof. Fixed so both compression and decompression require trusted OSCORE evidence.
